# overanimated-shop

Deliberately heavy 3D ecommerce showcase for VibeCheck dogfooding.

- Stack: Three.js, GSAP, Lenis, local GLB/HDR/AVIF/WebM assets
- Hub project_id: overanimated-shop
- Not a pnpm workspace package
- Upstream: https://github.com/Rahul-singh13/ciao-energy-3d-experience
- Pair with: examples/ai-saas-landing (Lumen SaaS twin)
